title: An ample line bundle has an affine section neighbourhood of a finite set
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal M$ an ample invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], $E\subseteq Y$ a finite set of points, and $W\subseteq Y$ open with $E\subseteq W$. There are $n>0$ and $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M^{\otimes n})$ with $E\subseteq Y_s\subseteq W$ and $Y_s$ affine.

proof.text: Assume first $E\neq\emptyset$ (the case $E=\emptyset$ is treated at the end). Since $Y$ carries the ample invertible sheaf $\mathcal M$, [lem-sc-ample-finite-set-affine] (Properties Lemma 01ZY), applied to $Y$ itself, gives an affine open $U'\subseteq Y$ with $E\subseteq U'$. Put $U=U'\cap W$, an open subset with $E\subseteq U\subseteq W$ (it need not be affine; the restriction of $\mathcal M$ to $W$ need not be ample, as $W$ need not be quasi-compact, so 01ZY is not applied to $W$).

source.place: Properties Lemma 09NV, proof, first paragraph: by Lemma 01ZY choose an affine open U subset W containing E

proof.text:
Put $S= igoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M^{\otimes n})$, a nonnegatively graded commutative ring. For each $e\in E$, let $\mathfrak p_e$ be the homogeneous prime of sections vanishing at $e$, and let $I\subset S_+$ be the graded ideal of positive-degree sections vanishing at every point of $Y\setminus U$. By [lem-sc-closed-subset-qc-ideal] choose a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_Y$ with $V(\mathcal J)=Y\setminus U$. For $e\in E$ we have $e\in U$, so $e
otin V(\mathcal J)$, and since $Y$ is quasi-compact (part of the ampleness of $\mathcal M$), [lem-sc-ample-ideal-section] gives $n>0$ and $u\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal J\mathcal M^{\otimes n})$ with $e\in Y_u$; at a point $y\in V(\mathcal J)$ the germ $u_y$ lies in $\mathcal J_y(\mathcal M^{\otimes n})_y\subseteq\mathfrak m_y(\mathcal M^{\otimes n})_y$, so $u$ vanishes on $Y\setminus U$. Thus $u\in I$ and $u
otin\mathfrak p_e$, i.e. $I
ot\subseteq\mathfrak p_e$ for every $e$. By graded prime avoidance [lem-sc-graded-prime-avoidance] (Algebra Lemma 00JS), there is a homogeneous positive-degree $s\in I$ outside every $\mathfrak p_e$.

source.place: Properties Lemma 09NV, proof, second paragraph: define S, p_x and I, use the basis of X_s and Algebra Lemma 00JS

proof.text: By the definitions of $I$ and $\mathfrak p_e$, $E\subseteq Y_s\subseteq U\subseteq W$. Since $U'$ is affine and $Y_s\subseteq U\subseteq U'$, [lem-sc-affine-cap-section-open] gives that $Y_s=U'\cap Y_s$ is affine. If $E$ is empty, take any positive tensor power and the zero section, whose nonvanishing locus is empty and affine.

source.place: Properties Lemma 09NV, proof, final paragraph: then E subset X_s subset U and X_s is affine by Lemma 01PV

lean.statement: theorem exists_affine_section_neighbourhood_of_finite (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsInvertible] (hM : IsAmple Y M) (E : Set Y) (hE : E.Finite) (W : Y.Opens) (hEW : E ⊆ (W : Set Y)) : ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∃ s : (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op ⊤), ∃ U : Y.Opens, E ⊆ (U : Set Y) ∧ U ≤ W ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∀ y : Y, y ∈ U ↔ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf ⊤ y trivial) s ∉ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Y.presheaf.stalk y)) • (⊤ : Submodule (Y.presheaf.stalk y) ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (M.tensorPow n).val.presheaf y))
